newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM PRICES DEC 11-17 STATE NOTES ISSUE AT PAR.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM PRICES DEC 11-17 STATE NOTES ISSUE AT PAR.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury said on Tuesday that state notes to be offered from Wednesday will be priced at par.

The Treasury is offering for sale to retail investors a five year 4.70 percent note, extendable to seven years, and a 3/5/7 note, which bears a revisable minimum coupon and has put options at five and seven years. The minimum coupons have been fixed at respectively 3.80, 4.80 and 5.60 percent respectively.
Subscriptions run until December 17. The notes will be issued on December 18.
It is the third time the Treasury is issuing state notes, a borrowing instrument created last summer which is aimed specifically at the general public.
The Treasury plans to carry out four such issues a year, raising around 85 billion Belgian francs a year toward its borrowing needs.

The last issue of state notes in September raised 19.95 billion francs. Then the Treasury offered a 5/7 year 5.45 percent note and a 3/5/7 note with minimum coupons of 4.50, 5.50 and 6.00 percent. -- Nick Antonovics, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710
